answer: A lease is physical and expiring: each epoch a head is live only if a shale secure module signs a fresh challenge and rebuys its terrace with marble; modules carrying one operator seed answer challenges in one serial queue, and the kth queued rebuy costs k marble while all k−1 earlier terraces stay paid. Honest first head: one module, 1 marble. n clones need n shale modules plus 1+…+n marble every epoch; a rented module still waits in that queue.
